<DOCSTRING>
Manages a collection of users and processes each user to determine if they are an adult or a minor.

This class is responsible for maintaining a list of users and processing each user to log whether they are an adult or a minor. It is used by various parts of the application to differentiate between adult and minor users for access control or other purposes.

@attribute {Array<Object>} users - The list of users managed by this class. It is initialized as an empty array and is modified by the `addUser` method.
</DOCSTRING>
